name: cl_pm_1500_candle_ema_15

source.title: Claude design panel 2026-10-20 (lens pm): the last-hour candle with the day's trend on NQ 15-minute bars, after the open-side FVG stops entering at 15:00. Why it should pay: from about 15:00 option-dealer hedging and leveraged-ETF / closing-auction rebalancing trade with the day's move into the close (the repo's 15:00 day-move follow held its unseen read); a 15:00-15:15 candle on the trend's side of the 20-bar EMA shows those flows have started. Who loses: late faders of the day's move and short-gamma hedgers forced to chase.

entry.words: Only the 15-minute candle of 15:00-15:15 ET is read (the entry window 15:15-15:30 holds its close and no other). It closes up with a body of at least 0.1 x ATR(14) (any real candle, not a doji) and the close is above the 20-bar EMA of 15-minute closes: buy at its close; closes down and below the EMA: sell. Stop at the candle's other extreme, target 1:1. Once a day, flat 15:58.

taught: [owner 2026-10-18, cl_disp15_ema_allday_k1p5] a candle followed at its close: stop = the candle's extreme, target 1:1
[owner 2026-10-11, families/_flex.py open layer] 'any time window, any indicator': an entry window and an indicator gate on any family
[Claude 2026-10-20, cl_disp15_ema_allday_k1p5] the EMA20 side gate on 15-minute bars (long only above, short only below)

[Claude design panel 2026-10-20] the 15:00 candle only: the last hour, after the open-side FVG's 15:00 entry cut-off, the hour where the 15:00 day-move follow (nq_pm_day_move_1500) found its edge; k 0.1 is displace's floor, so the size test only drops dojis
not_run: THE FAMILY: win_candle start 15:00 is the plain form of this rule, but `taught check` refuses win_candle outside nyam (it reads the family's passes with its default start 09:30); displace with its floor k 0.1 and a 15:15-15:30 entry window is the same candle follow.
THE GATE: the open layer's price_ema(20) on the 15-minute closes since 00:00 ET, read at the 15:15 close (above = long side, below = short side); a candle against it is no trade.
THE SHORT HOLD: entries at 15:15, flat 15:58: a trade that reaches neither stop nor target leaves on the clock.
THE STOP: the candle's other extreme, floored at 0.25 x ATR when nearer.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay).
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ: build days only.
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days).
